report_name: UK Education Tech Firm Bromcom Suffers Single Sign-On Data Breach

threat_actors.name: Unauthorized Party
threat_actors.description: An unknown threat actor who gained unauthorized access to Bromcom's legacy SSO system and exfiltrated user registration data, likely through exploiting an unpatched vulnerability or misconfiguration.

attack_patterns.name: Exploit Public-Facing Application
attack_patterns.description: The attacker exploited a public-facing legacy single sign-on (SSO) system, likely through an unpatched vulnerability or misconfiguration, to gain initial access to the server environment.

attack_patterns.name: Data from Information Repositories
attack_patterns.description: After gaining access, the attacker retrieved and exfiltrated user registration data, including email addresses and sign-in metadata, from the compromised server environment.

identities.name: Bromcom
identities.description: A UK-based software provider for educational institutions whose legacy SSO system was breached, leading to the exfiltration of user registration data.

infrastructure.name: Bromcom Legacy SSO System
infrastructure.description: A legacy single sign-on (SSO) system, including its Communication Server environment, that was compromised by an unauthorized party. The system was decommissioned following the breach.
